decisions.reason: The online customer portal is a visible digital investment aligned with the announced direction of deeper customer collaboration and information security, so management will persist with it even if early uptake is modest.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 makes this packaging display a publicly celebrated showcase of the firm's problem-solving innovation and sustainability, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core display business, has its own website page as a visible commitment, and uses existing capacity at little extra cost.
The small counter display is a core-adjacent standard product with its own page, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary market conditions.
The large freestanding information display fits the announced broadening of 3D cardboard offerings and is publicly presented, so management will keep it.
